name: Table
description: A table displays rows of data.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Whether to show all table borders
props.descriptionZh: 是否展示外边框和列边框

props.name: classes
props.description: Customize class for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function.
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数

props.name: column
props.description: Default props for every column. See [Column](#column). It only applies when the column does not define the same property.
props.descriptionZh: 统一列配置，参考 [Column](#column)，仅在单列未声明同名属性时生效

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns of table
props.descriptionZh: 表格列的配置描述，具体项见下表

props.name: components
props.description: Override default table elements
props.descriptionZh: 覆盖默认的 table 元素

props.name: dataSource
props.description: Data record array to be displayed
props.descriptionZh: 数据数组

props.name: expandable
props.description: Config expandable content
props.descriptionZh: 配置展开属性

props.name: getPopupContainer
props.description: The render container of dropdowns in table
props.descriptionZh: 设置表格内各类浮层的渲染节点，如筛选菜单

props.name: loading
props.description: Loading status of table
props.descriptionZh: 页面是否加载中

props.name: locale
props.description: The i18n text including filter, sort, empty text, etc
props.descriptionZh: 默认文案设置，目前包括排序、过滤、空数据文案

props.name: pagination
props.description: Config of pagination. You can ref table pagination [config](#pagination) or full [`pagination`](/components/pagination/) document, hide it by setting it to `false`
props.descriptionZh: 分页器，参考[配置项](#pagination)或 [pagination](/components/pagination-cn) 文档，设为 false 时不展示和进行分页

props.name: rowClassName
props.description: Row's className
props.descriptionZh: 表格行的类名

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Row's unique key, could be a string or function that returns a string
props.descriptionZh: 表格行 key 的取值，可以是字符串或一个函数

props.name: rowSelection
props.description: Row selection [config](#rowselection)
props.descriptionZh: 表格行是否可选择，[配置项](#rowselection)

props.name: rowHoverable
props.description: Row hover
props.descriptionZh: 表格行是否开启 hover 交互

props.name: scroll
props.description: Whether the table can be scrollable, [config](#scroll)
props.descriptionZh: 表格是否可滚动，也可以指定滚动区域的宽、高，[配置项](#scroll)

props.name: showHeader
props.description: Whether to show table header
props.descriptionZh: 是否显示表头

props.name: showSorterTooltip
props.description: The header show next sorter direction tooltip. It will be set as the property of Tooltip if its type is object
props.descriptionZh: 表头是否显示下一次排序的 tooltip 提示。当参数类型为对象时，将被设置为 Tooltip 的属性

props.name: size
props.description: Size of table
props.descriptionZh: 表格大小

props.name: sortDirections
props.description: Supported sort way, could be `ascend`, `descend`
props.descriptionZh: 支持的排序方式，取值为 `ascend` `descend`

props.name: sticky
props.type: boolean \| `{offsetHeader?: number, offsetScroll?: number, getContainer?: () => HTMLElement}`
props.description: Set sticky header and scroll bar
props.descriptionZh: 设置粘性头部和滚动条

props.name: styles
props.description: Customize inline style for each semantic structure inside the component. Supports object or function.
props.descriptionZh: 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数

props.name: summary
props.description: Summary content renderer. You can also use the `#summary` slot.
props.descriptionZh: 总结栏，也可以使用 `#summary` 插槽

props.name: tableLayout
props.default: -<hr />`fixed` when header/columns are fixed, or using `column.ellipsis`
props.description: The [table-layout](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/table-layout) attribute of table element
props.descriptionZh: 表格元素的 [table-layout](https://developer.mozilla.org/zh-CN/docs/Web/CSS/table-layout) 属性，设为 `fixed` 表示内容不会影响列的布局

props.name: title
props.description: Table title renderer. You can also use the `#title` slot.
props.descriptionZh: 表格标题，也可以使用 `#title` 插槽

props.name: virtual
props.description: Support virtual list
props.descriptionZh: 支持虚拟列表

props.name: footer
props.descriptionZh: 表格尾部，也可以使用 `#footer` 插槽

events.name: change
events.type: (     pagination: TablePaginationConfig,     filters: Record<string, FilterValue \| null>,     sorter: SorterResult<RecordType> \| SorterResult<RecordType>[],     extra: TableCurrentDataSource<RecordType>,   ) => void
events.description: Callback executed when pagination, filters or sorter is changed
events.descriptionZh: 分页、排序、筛选变化时触发

events.name: scroll
events.description: Whether the table can be scrollable, [config](#scroll)
events.descriptionZh: 表格是否可滚动，也可以指定滚动区域的宽、高，[配置项](#scroll)

events.name: headerRow
events.description: Set props on per header row

slots.name: expandedRowRender
slots.type: (ctx: { record: RecordType, index: number, indent: number, expanded: boolean }) => any

slots.name: headerCell
slots.type: (ctx: { column: ColumnType<RecordType>, index: number, text: any }) => any

slots.name: bodyCell
slots.type: (ctx: { column: ColumnType<RecordType>, index: number, text: any, record: RecordType }) => any

properties.name: align
properties.description: The specify which way that column is aligned
properties.descriptionZh: 设置列的对齐方式

properties.name: className
properties.description: The className of this column
properties.descriptionZh: 列样式类名

properties.name: colSpan
properties.description: Span of this column's title
properties.descriptionZh: 表头列合并，设置为 0 时，不渲染

properties.name: dataIndex
properties.description: Display field of the data record, support nest path by string array
properties.descriptionZh: 列数据在数据项中对应的路径，支持通过数组查询嵌套路径

properties.name: defaultFilteredValue
properties.description: Default filtered values
properties.descriptionZh: 默认筛选值

properties.name: filterResetToDefaultFilteredValue
properties.description: click the reset button, whether to restore the default filter
properties.descriptionZh: 点击重置按钮的时候，是否恢复默认筛选值

properties.name: defaultSortOrder
properties.description: Default order of sorted values
properties.descriptionZh: 默认排序顺序

properties.name: ellipsis
properties.description:
The ellipsis cell content, not working with sorter and filters for now.
tableLayout would be `fixed` when `ellipsis` is `true` or `{ showTitle?: boolean }`
properties.descriptionZh:
超过宽度将自动省略，暂不支持和排序筛选一起使用。
设置为 `true` 或 `{ showTitle?: boolean }` 时，表格布局将变成 `tableLayout="fixed"`。

properties.name: filterDropdown
properties.description: Customized filter overlay
properties.descriptionZh: 可以自定义筛选菜单，此函数只负责渲染图层，需要自行编写各种交互

properties.name: filtered
properties.description: Whether the `dataSource` is filtered
properties.descriptionZh: 是否处于筛选状态

properties.name: filteredValue
properties.description: Controlled filtered value, filter icon will highlight
properties.descriptionZh: 筛选的受控属性，外界可用此控制列的筛选状态，值为已筛选的 value 数组

properties.name: filterIcon
properties.description: Customized filter icon
properties.descriptionZh: 自定义 filter 图标。

properties.name: filterOnClose
properties.description: Whether to trigger filter when the filter menu closes
properties.descriptionZh: 是否在筛选菜单关闭时触发筛选

properties.name: filterMultiple
properties.description: Whether multiple filters can be selected
properties.descriptionZh: 是否多选

properties.name: filterMode
properties.description: To specify the filter interface
properties.descriptionZh: 指定筛选菜单的用户界面

properties.name: filterSearch
properties.description: Whether to be searchable for filter menu
properties.descriptionZh: 筛选菜单项是否可搜索

properties.name: filters
properties.description: Filter menu config
properties.descriptionZh: 表头的筛选菜单项

properties.name: filterDropdownProps
properties.description: Customized dropdown props
properties.descriptionZh: 自定义下拉属性

properties.name: fixed
properties.description: (IE not support) Set column to be fixed: `true`(same as `'start'`) `'start'` `'end'`
properties.descriptionZh: （IE 下无效）列是否固定，可选 `true` (等效于 `'start'`) `'start'` `'end'`

properties.name: key
properties.description: Unique key of this column, you can ignore this prop if you've set a unique `dataIndex`
properties.descriptionZh: Vue 需要的 key，如果已经设置了唯一的 `dataIndex`，可以忽略这个属性

properties.name: render
properties.type: (value: V, record: T, index: number): VueNode
properties.description: Renderer of the table cell. `value` is the value of current cell; `record` is the value object of current row; `index` is the row number. The return value should be a VueNode
properties.descriptionZh: 生成复杂数据的渲染函数，参数分别为当前单元格的值，当前行数据，行索引

properties.name: responsive
properties.description: The list of breakpoints at which to display this column. Always visible if not set
properties.descriptionZh: 响应式 breakpoint 配置列表。未设置则始终可见。

properties.name: rowScope
properties.description: Set scope attribute for all cells in this column
properties.descriptionZh: 设置列范围

properties.name: shouldCellUpdate
properties.description: Control cell render logic
properties.descriptionZh: 自定义单元格渲染时机

properties.name: showSorterTooltip
properties.description: If header show next sorter direction tooltip, override `showSorterTooltip` in table
properties.descriptionZh: 表头显示下一次排序的 tooltip 提示, 覆盖 table 中 `showSorterTooltip`

properties.name: sortDirections
properties.description: Supported sort way, override `sortDirections` in `Table`, could be `ascend`, `descend`
properties.descriptionZh: 支持的排序方式，覆盖 `Table` 中 `sortDirections`， 取值为 `ascend` `descend`

properties.name: sorter
properties.type: function \| boolean \| \{ compare: function, multiple: number \}
properties.description: Sort function for local sort, see [Array.sort](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/sort)'s compareFunction. If it is server-side sorting, set to `true`, but if you want to support multi-column sorting, you can set it to `{ multiple: number }`
properties.descriptionZh: 排序函数，本地排序使用一个函数(参考 [Array.sort](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/sort) 的 compareFunction)。需要服务端排序可设为 `true`（单列排序） 或 `{ multiple: number }`（多列排序）

properties.name: sortOrder
properties.description: Order of sorted values: `ascend` `descend` `null`
properties.descriptionZh: 排序的受控属性，外界可用此控制列的排序，可设置为 `ascend` `descend` `null`

properties.name: sortIcon
properties.description: Customized sort icon
properties.descriptionZh: 自定义 sort 图标

properties.name: title
properties.description: Title of this column
properties.descriptionZh: 列头显示文字（函数用法 `3.10.0` 后支持）

properties.descriptionZh: 设置头部单元格属性

properties.name: title
properties.description: Title of the column group

properties.description: Customize table element

properties.descriptionZh: 自定义表头 table 元素

properties.description: Customize header wrapper element
properties.descriptionZh: 自定义表头 wrapper 元素

properties.description: Customize header row element

properties.name: header.cell
properties.description: Customize header cell element
properties.descriptionZh: 自定义表头单元格元素

properties.descriptionZh: 自定义表体单元格元素

properties.descriptionZh: 自定义展开图标，参考[示例](https://stackblitz.com/edit/vitejs-vite-jezqinto?file=src%2FApp.vue)

properties.name: x
